name: resqmeal
description: ResQ Meal monorepo — orchestrates frontend, backend, and shared tooling

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:fullstack: npm run db:init && npm run dev:all
scripts.build:fullstack: npm run build -w frontend && node backend/scripts/maven-package.mjs
